Badanie sygnałów od DMS

sig_files <- list.files("../output_yeast/DMS_signal", full.names = TRUE)
sig_files
##  [1] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr01.tsv"
##  [2] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr02.tsv"
##  [3] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr03.tsv"
##  [4] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr04.tsv"
##  [5] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr05.tsv"
##  [6] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr06.tsv"
##  [7] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr07.tsv"
##  [8] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr08.tsv"
##  [9] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr09.tsv"
## [10] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr10.tsv"
## [11] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr11.tsv"
## [12] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr12.tsv"
## [13] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr13.tsv"
## [14] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr14.tsv"
## [15] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr15.tsv"
## [16] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chr16.tsv"
## [17] "../output_yeast/DMS_signal/chrMt.tsv"
combined_df <- data.frame()
d_S <- c()
chrs <- c()
for (sf in sig_files) {
  df <- read.table(sf, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
  chr <- basename(sf) %>% str_remove(".tsv")
  df$chr <- chr
  df$position <- 1:nrow(df)
  colnames(df) <- c("base", "signal", "chr", "position")

  n <- df %>%
    filter(signal > 0) %>%
    dim()
  n <- n[1]
  l <- dim(df)[1]
  chrs <- append(chrs, c(chr))
  d_S <- append(d_S, c(n / l))
  combined_df <- rbind(combined_df, df)
}
head(combined_df)
##   base signal   chr position
## 1    C      0 chr01        1
## 2    C      0 chr01        2
## 3    A      0 chr01        3
## 4    C      0 chr01        4
## 5    A      0 chr01        5
## 6    C      0 chr01        6

Liczba sygnalow znormalizowana do dlugosci chromosmu

d_S <- data.frame(chr = chrs, d = d_S)
mean(d_S$d)
## [1] 0.03077083
sd(d_S$d)
## [1] 0.005014966

Rozkład sygnałów na chromosomach

p <- combined_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = position, y = signal, col = chr)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~chr,
    scales = "free_x", ncol = 1,
    strip.position = "left"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
  )
ggsave(
  "fig/signal.png",
  plot = p, width = 10,
  height = 12, dpi = 300
)

Wczytanie danych

df <- read.csv("../output_yeast/structures/combined.csv", header = TRUE)
replacements <- c("VS" = "in silico", "VC" = "consensus", "VG" = "guided")
df$struktura <- str_replace_all(df$struktura, replacements)
df <- df %>%
  filter(IA > 0.2)

Badanie rozkładu danych i obserwacji wpływowych w modelach regresji ze zmiennymi kategorycznymi

shapiro.test(df$SS)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  df$SS
## W = 0.92876, p-value = 6.999e-11
shapiro.test(df$CS)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  df$CS
## W = 0.91665, p-value = 5.814e-12
p <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = SS)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  stat_theodensity(aes(y = after_stat(count)), col = "blue", lwd = 1) +
  ylab("Liczba obserwacji") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, face = "italic"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
  )
p

ggsave(
  "fig/SS.png",
  plot = p, width = 15,
  height = 10, dpi = 300
)

p <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = CS)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.03) +
  stat_theodensity(aes(y = after_stat(count) * 0.03), col = "blue", lwd = 1) +
  ylab("Liczba obserwacji") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, face = "italic"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
  )
p

ggsave(
  "fig/CS.png",
  plot = p, width = 15,
  height = 10, dpi = 300
)
